title: Endless Holidays
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq T \leq 10^5; 1 \leq N \leq 10^5; N-1 \leq M \leq 10^5; 1 \leq U_i \lt V_i \leq N; Any pair of cities can be reached from each other by traversing some roads.; 2 \leq W \leq 10; T,N,M,U_i,V_i,W are integers.; S_i is a string of length W consisting of o, x.; The sum of N over all test cases is at most 10^5.; The sum of M over all test cases is at most 10^5.
